definitions.explanation: To put on clothing worn on the upper body or full body (shirts, jackets, dresses). Different verbs are used for lower body, head, and accessories.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{何|なに}を{着|き}ますか？
コートを{着|き}てください。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{赤|あか}いドレスを{着|き}ています。
examples.english: She is wearing a red dress.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xを{着|き}る (wear/put on X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {着|き}ている = 'is wearing' (not 'is putting on').

COMMON PATTERNS:
・コートを{着|き}る (put on/wear a coat)
・{着|き}ている (is wearing - state)
・{着|き}替|か}える (change clothes)
・{着物|きもの}を{着|き}る (wear kimono)

CLOTHING VERBS:
・{着|き}る: upper body/full body
・はく: pants, shoes, skirts
・かぶる: hats
・する: accessories

Opposite: {脱|ぬ}ぐ (take off). Don't confuse with {切|き}る (to cut - godan).
